title: 2.3.21 A14.1 Car on a Ramp
description: Build a two-wheeled car using WheelJoints and drive it up a ramp with WASD. The harder of the two A14.1 options.

steps.title: Ground + ramp
steps.instructions: Two static sprites: a flat ground and a tilted ramp. Set the ramp's .rotation in radians to tilt it.
hints: The Sprite docs chapter (right drawer → Docs tab) covers static colliders.
ramp.rotation = -Math.PI / 8 tilts up to the right; positive values tilt the other way.

steps.title: Chassis + wheels
steps.instructions: Chassis: one dynamic rectangle. Two wheels: dynamic sprites with a `diameter` so they're circular.
hints: Place the wheels slightly below the chassis corners so the joints have room.
The Physics docs chapter explains dynamic vs static bodies.

steps.title: Join the wheels with WheelJoint
steps.instructions: new WheelJoint(chassis, leftWheel) and again for the right wheel.
hints: The Joints docs chapter covers WheelJoint — including suspension travel options.

steps.title: Drive with WASD
steps.instructions: In draw(), use kb.pressing('a') / kb.pressing('d') to set each wheel.angularVelocity. Drive both wheels for all-wheel drive.
hints: Open the Input docs chapter for kb.pressing. Don't use arrow keys — they scroll the editor.

requirements.title: Static geometry exists
requirements.description: Create at least one 'static' sprite (ground or ramp)

requirements.title: Gravity enabled
requirements.description: Assign a positive value to world.gravity.y

requirements.title: WASD drives wheels
requirements.description: Use kb.pressing with 'a' or 'd' inside draw()
